notes.title: ‼ Really worth to read 👇🏻
notes.notes:
Good Day, Fellow Informative Warriors 🍄 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25700282/ab504a2c35d2c6944f9cdcfc0a15b10c04812fbc.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25700282/cb5d6e1c4bc52dfe7079b894f201ab63bd2a72b8.png[/img][/url]
Some of you might have heard a few unofficial statements directly from our CEO on discord about the recent update. Today we decided to gather all of those statements in one place, add a few others and make them all official!
These words are more or less directly from the Developers on the reason of the previous update:

🍄 Developers has tried their best to save cross-platform multiplayer between PC and mobile for more than 2 years without succussion. But the mobile version is developing faster and it has become harder to have cross-platform play while trying to keep it fair enough for both versions. 

🍄 After an extremely long and hard debate that lasted weeks between everyone in charge, the only logical conclusion that Zillion Whales reached was to move ahead with the update we got. There only two other possibilities were to either disconnect PC from the mobile server or implement the same free-2-play mechanics on Steam to keep it fair against mobile. Unfortunately the second solution requires a lot of development resources and time, and they were not ready to disconnect the PC from the mobile. So the developers found a middle ground option and turned off Passive Skills for PC and keep it cross-platform. Developers realized that trying to have it be equally fair for both mobile and PC was a mistake. They decided to rather put full concentration on developing more quality content for mobile!

🍄 The recent update has had a positive reception on mobile and has helped Zillion Whales to continue their work on our favourite game with a brand new passion and spirit! From now on, full concentration on new in game content is the goal for this year continuing into the beginning of next!

🍄 Yeah, of course everyone would have liked to keep it cross platform as it has been since forever, but sadly reality prevents cross-platform era to exist. We are sorry to say a change that will be adapted soon to our servers is that Steam players will only be able to play against other Steam players. To compensate for this, those Generals that wants to move their accounts to the mobile version and keep playing there, will not start off from the beginning as if they were a new General. Rather they will be compensated with bonuses once the change is made. These bonuses has not been fully decided just yet, but promised to be significant. 

🍄 To end it all, a few insights of what the next few changes are going to be. Yes, Chia's Stones will finally be nerfed in the next update. As well as in future updates will include an increase in the amount of ways to earn both Gold and Runes. As you might have seen, we have already started making significant changes in prizing for Cups Events. This will continue into our standards Community Contest as well!

🍄 We also want to thank all of our lovely and loyal Generals that has stayed with us through thick and thin! We obviously could not have done this without you and we honestly hope to please you in every single way possible. This has been an extremely rough time for us, so our appreciation for you has been equally extreme. Hopefully we'll get through this together, Good Luck On The Battlefields Generals! 

Love and War, from everyone in the Zillion Whales Team 😍

🍄 What's happened?
First of all, we have parted ways with our previous Partners and Friends at OPNoobs! 😱 We had a great run that lasted slightly more than 1 year and we wish them all the best fortune in the future! That does NOT mean that we will no longer have Tournaments of course, it only means that we will hopefully be trying to succeed at these events within our own community instead! 

🍄 So what does this really mean for the Warriors of Mushroom Wars? 
The big change you will feel in our new community hosted events might be the fact that in overall, the energy and vibe of these new Tournament Cups will be LESS serious than previously. WE KNOW, we asked ourselves the very same, IS THAT EVEN POSSIBLE!? Well yes, yes it is! 

🍄 What will be the changes?
Besides the fact that we will no longer provide any Steam Keys to anyone, mostly because it wasn't a very popular prize to start off with. But in the beginning we will also only have 2 Casters during the Sunday Streams! 🤩

🍄 Further Info?
As always, if you've ever got any question, please feel free to always ask us! If you join our [url=https://discord.gg/BqsS9kd]Discord[/url] you can tag [b][u]@Cup Master[/u][/b] and 1 out of the 8 Cup Masters will hopefully help you out asap! These new changes are the only details worth sharing at the moment, but there will definitely be more in the future about topics such expanding our Cup Masters Team, perhaps with 3rd potential Caster! 

🍄 Conclusion?
More or less, the rest of these events will hopefully run as smooth as always, just with hopefully a bright new spark in them! As mentioned previously, we will be relying just slightly more on you, our community, to help us out when it gets rough. And as always, if you've ever got Practical, New and Fun ideas for your Tournaments, always tell us! 

🍄 FINALLY!

notes.title: Moving around the map
notes.notes:
Good Day, Fellow Faster Warriors! 🏃‍♂🍄
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25700282/f9437bec86fb88ecf22e4ec0234121f41d41049b.png[/img]
Today we will be addressing something that is most highly important to becoming a Great General, the speed of your moving units! This will of course help you achieve a greater Offence and more importantly, a greater Defense!

As you might know, Travel Speed of Units can rely on a great amount of things! Previously we have discussed how Moral affects your overall gameplay. So for more moral information, find our previous Moral post!

But there are certainly other things that could affect the Travel Speed. The 2 biggest factors are of course Hero Abilities as well as the very new, Passive Abilities!

🍄 Hero Abilities such as Rudo Speed, Ayner Rage, Trini Bees and Kenor Close Ranks are all abilities that affect the speed of your marching units. There are many more and for a more detailed and informative list please visit this link!
http://www.mw2.su/en/physics_en/mapmovement/

🍄 Passive Abilities, specifically the new UNITS; Speed can increase your Travel Speed permanently.
🕳 Tier 1 +3% Speed
🕳 Tier 2 +7% Speed
🕳 Tier 3 +15% Speed

Let’s move on to the 2 Types of Unit Movement! Either Standard Waves, or Snaking.
🍄 Standard Waves – simply use the standard technique of sending units by dragging and releasing/pressing. Each Full Wave will have 8 Units in 1 line marching
🍄 Snaking – many compact Waves all pressed closer together to decrease the empty room between the Marching Units.

For More info please visit the official MW2 website and read for yourself here http://www.mw2.su/en/physics_en/mapmovement/

Good Luck Generals, Speed you on the battlefield! 😉

notes.title: What is Energy? 🔋
notes.notes:
Good Day, Fellow Energic Warriors! 🍄
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25700282/057214f77005a7b9470119a154cd56de637a7c47.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25700282/72b11f7b0e90d3c357cbf15804b0740a1294bb26.png[/img][/url]
As you all, know each hero on Mushroom Wars 2 has its own unique and special set of Abilities. To be able to use these Abilities, the hero needs to spend some 🔋 Energy 🔋 to activate them!

Energy, or Ability Bar, can be translated into points! At max, when the Ability Bar is full with Energy, there are 500 points that are available for your access. This could be for example 5 different 1st Ability usage. Even a combination of 2nd and 3rd together as well as of course 1st and 4th! To simplify it, 1 Ability equals to 100 points!

Every Ability also has a cooldown system built in. The higher the level of Ability, the more time you’ll have to wait to use it again. Here are how much an Ability requires;

🔋 1st level Ability - 100 Energy points - 20 seconds cooldown.
🔋 2nd level Ability - 200 Energy points - 40 seconds cooldown.
🔋 3rd level Ability - 300 Energy points - 70 seconds cooldown.
🔋 4th level Ability - 400 Energy points - 100 seconds cooldown.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25700282/e22dd6e232ebaf6fa401fe675e51667087f9363f.png[/img]
There are only 2 ways of collecting and receiving Energy:
⚡ Either you collect them by default Time which means that for each 1 second that goes by it also translates to 2,5 Energy Point.
⚡ Or you can also collect Energy Points by simply killing of your own units in battle. Upgrading Villages or Towers does not classify as killing own units!

There is a much more detailed information 🤓 on how to gain Energy Points that you can read more about here http://www.mw2.su/en/physics_en/energy_and_skills/. This further info contains precise measurements of Energy Points of Dead Units and other stuff

Recently we have also had the big change of Rush Mode during battles! This mode gets activated 2 minutes (120 seconds) into every single Multiplayer, 2v2 and Custom Gamemode, but not Campaign. Rush Mode means Double Energy Points collection and half Cooldown System for every ability. The main reason for Rush Mode is to not prolong Battles more than necessary and for longer maps to have a more exciting feeling to them!

Tell us what you learned today, and tell us if we missed something that you know about Energy that we didn’t mention today! 😉

🍄 The Third Big Change is that all in game prizes (except participation) that are won for playing the tournament will be Halved! notes.title: Morale Info
notes.notes:
Good Day, Fellow Mechanical Warriors! 🍄

[url=http://www.mw2.su/en/physics_en/morale/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25700282/17e0eb5d03aa1824332149cb345d1482c2603c3e.png[/img][/url]
There are many ways to become an overall stronger player and make sure that you keep winning all your Wars! One of the best ways is to understand the Game’s Mechanics that are presented to you.

Today we’re going to talk about the usage of Morale ☀☀☀☀☀ to your advantage and how to correctly use it in all situations, both attack and defense! Morale is the reason that an unfair battle can be balanced out, Morale is what helps you make a great comeback after a tough situation and Morale will always be your best friend in every War!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25700282/2a504c1da7f939f57695c63a548dac9821f2331c.png[/img]

The only thing that truly matters with Morale is that the more you have of it, the better your position is! Morale is represented with Suns and you can have all from 0 to 5 Suns at max. Half Suns don’t count; they only show how far you are from the closest whole Sun.

The following information describes how your Villages and Units corresponds to your Morale.
At the very beginning of a game when you start off with 0 Morale, your Villages will defend at 100% per unit. Meaning for every 10 Units your opponent attacks you with, 10 of your own Units will also be lost in the battle. Same goes for how strong your Units are once you attack them. At 0 Morale you Units also march at 100% the speed. Here we are not considering the remaining coefficients of your defense. For example what kind of building that is being attacked and how many forges the Opponent owns. We’re talking only about Morale coefficient so keep that in mind. There are a lot of other things which affect on attack and defence coefficients which we might be telling you about in future posts.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25700282/a0c741335b8739d8e5504815e2505947181940c1.png[/img]

These Percentages corresponds with how high your Morale is at the moment. Meaning that the higher the Morale you have, the Stronger and Faster your Units will be! 💪

Increase and decrease of Morale generally has to do with what is going on with your Units in the battle, but there are other factors too. The fastest and easiest way to receive higher Morale is to Conquer all kind of Villages, both opponents and Neutrals 👍. Another, much safer way, for a higher Morale is to keep Upgrading all your buildings, both the Towers and the Huts. Once the upgrade is finished, you will receive a small amount of Suns. The most common way to receive High Morale is to defending attacks from your opponents; this will also lead to a greater loss in their Units than your own! Finally the last way of getting a Higher Morale is to use your own Tower to shoot down Opponents Moving Units. Once a tower exterminates an enemy Units, it transfers into a very small amount of Suns for you.
You can find full list of ways to receive Morale here http://www.mw2.su/en/physics_en/morale/

The goal with Morale is to always be the one with the highest among all your opponents! A great thing to do whenever you find yourself in situation with less Morale than your opponent's, is to keep defending their attacks, using Units and Abilities, but also importantly not to attack them until you have a higher Morale than they do!
